changes.summary: Atomic revision 2 adds the OWN-03 telemetry off-switch question. Integration preparation repeated a bounded scan of the pinned public source with named paths and search terms (telemetry-code-scan) and found no ADE-vendor usage, diagnostic or crash sender, so the default is no telemetry and the off-switch location stays unknown. Other OWN-03 atomic answers are kept from agent:ADE-193-source; the claim awaits a new independent review.

before.telemetry_defaults: Production Rust search for telemetry/posthog/sentry/analytics found no analytics sender or consent toggle. Release builds do query GitHub for updates after startup and every four hours; source branch builds skip it. This is not a contractual no-collection assertion.

after.telemetry_defaults: No ADE telemetry in the pinned public source: a bounded scan of crates, Cargo.toml, packaging, scripts and website for telemetry, analytics, PostHog, Segment, Sentry, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Bugsnag, Datadog and crash-reporting terms found no Arbor usage, diagnostic or crash sender; the only match is a GitHub GraphQL schema field for Copilot. Release builds query GitHub for updates after startup and every four hours; that update lookup is not a usage or crash report. This is not a contractual no-collection promise.
after.telemetry_off_switch: Not applicable: the bounded scan found no ADE-vendor telemetry sender in the scoped public source, so there is nothing to switch off and no off-switch location is recorded. Absence of a sender is not a closed-service or private-build promise; external CLI/provider telemetry and task-data transport have their own controls.
